chunks.heading: Choosing a Grind & Brewing Guide
chunks.text:
# Choosing a Grind & Brewing Guide

The single most common support question we get is "which grind do I pick?" Here's the
whole answer.
chunks.title: Choosing a Grind & Brewing Guide

chunks.heading: Pick your grind by your brewer
chunks.text:
## Pick your grind by your brewer

| Your brewer | Choose | Looks like |
|---|---|---|
| Espresso machine | **Espresso** | Powdered sugar |
| Moka pot / stovetop | **Espresso** | Powdered sugar |
| Aeropress | **Filter** | Table salt |
| V60, Chemex, pour-over | **Filter** | Table salt |
| Drip machine (Mr. Coffee, Technivorm) | **Filter** | Table salt |
| French press | **French Press** | Coarse sea salt |
| Cold brew | **French Press** | Coarse sea salt |
| Percolator | **French Press** | Coarse sea salt |
| You own a grinder | **Whole Bean** | — |

If you're between two, choose the **finer** one. Coffee that's too coarse tastes weak
and sour; too fine tastes bitter but at least tastes like something.

**Nespresso and Keurig machines take proprietary pods. Our coffee doesn't work in
them** unless you have a refillable capsule, in which case order Espresso grind.
chunks.title: Choosing a Grind & Brewing Guide

chunks.heading: Which coffee should I get?
chunks.text:
## Which coffee should I get?

- **New to specialty coffee, drink it black or with a splash:** Huila Reserve
- **You take it with milk or make lattes:** Volcán Dark
- **You want fruit and acidity, you brew pour-over:** Nariño Microlot
- **You want something easy that works everywhere:** Casa Blend
- **Evening or caffeine-sensitive:** Sereno Decaf (sugarcane process, not chemical)
chunks.title: Choosing a Grind & Brewing Guide

chunks.heading: Basic recipes
chunks.text:
## Basic recipes

**Pour-over (V60, 1 cup)**
22 g coffee, filter grind, 360 g water at 96 °C. Bloom with 60 g for 40 seconds, then
pour in stages to 360 g. Done around 2:45.

**French press (1 L)**
60 g coffee, coarse grind, 900 g water just off boil. Stir at 1 minute, wait to 4
minutes, press slowly, decant immediately so it doesn't keep extracting.

**Aeropress (1 cup)**
15 g coffee, filter grind, 220 g water at 90 °C. Stir 10 seconds, steep 1:30, press for
30 seconds.

**Espresso**
18 g in, 36 g out, 25–30 seconds. If it runs fast and tastes sour, grind finer. If it
chokes and tastes bitter, grind coarser. Change one thing at a time.
chunks.title: Choosing a Grind & Brewing Guide

chunks.heading: Troubleshooting
chunks.text:
## Troubleshooting

| It tastes… | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Sour, thin, empty | Under-extracted | Grind finer, hotter water, or brew longer |
| Bitter, dry, harsh | Over-extracted | Grind coarser, cooler water, or brew shorter |
| Weak but not sour | Not enough coffee | Raise the dose, keep the ratio |
| Muddy, silty | Grind too fine for the brewer | Go coarser |
| Flat, papery | Age | Check the roast date |

Standard ratio to start from: **1 g coffee to 16 g water**. Weigh it once and you'll
never guess again — a kitchen scale is the cheapest upgrade in coffee.
chunks.title: Choosing a Grind & Brewing Guide

chunks.heading: Caffeine
chunks.text:
## Caffeine

A 250 g bag makes roughly 14 cups at our standard ratio. A brewed cup is around
95–120 mg of caffeine; espresso is about 65 mg per shot. Decaf is not caffeine-free —
it retains roughly **2–3%** of the original caffeine, about 3 mg per cup.

> We can tell you what's in the coffee. We can't tell you how much caffeine is right
> for you — if you have a medical reason to limit caffeine, that's a conversation for
> your doctor, not for us.

chunks.heading: Orders
chunks.text:
## Orders

**Where is my order?**
Tracking is emailed on the ship day. If it's been more than 5 business days with no
movement, contact us and we'll open a trace and reship.

**Can I change my order after placing it?**
Yes, until the roast-day cut-off (11:00 AM ET the day before roasting). After that the
bag is roasted and labelled.

**Can I add to an existing order?**
Only before the cut-off, and only by messaging us — the store can't merge orders
automatically.

**Do you offer gift notes?**
Yes. There's a note field at checkout, printed on a card, no pricing shown on the
packing slip for gift orders.
chunks.title: Frequently Asked Questions

chunks.heading: Product
chunks.text:
## Product

**Is your coffee organic?**
No. We are not certified organic and we don't claim to be. Several of our producers
farm without synthetic inputs, but without certification we won't put the word on a bag.

**Is it fair trade?**
Not certified. We publish what we pay per kilo of green coffee on each product page,
which is above the Fair Trade floor. We think the number is more useful than the label.

**Do you sell decaf?**
Yes — Sereno Decaf, sugarcane (ethyl acetate) process. No methylene chloride.

**Are your bags recyclable?**
The bags are multi-layer and are **not** curbside recyclable. The valve and the tin tie
are the problem. We're working on it and we're not going to pretend otherwise.

**Do you sell whole bean and ground?**
Both. Whole bean if you have a grinder; otherwise pick your grind by brewer — see the
brewing guide.
chunks.title: Frequently Asked Questions

chunks.heading: Account & payment
chunks.text:
## Account & payment

**What payment methods do you take?**
All major cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Shop Pay. No PayPal, no crypto, no purchase
orders.

**Do you store my card?**
Card details are held by Shopify Payments. We never see or store full card numbers.

**Can I use two discount codes?**
No — one code per order. The subscriber discount applies automatically on top of a code.
chunks.title: Frequently Asked Questions

chunks.heading: Shipping
chunks.text:
## Shipping

**Do you ship internationally?**
No. US, DC and Puerto Rico only.

**How fast is shipping?**
1–2 days in the Southeast, up to 6 days on the West Coast, counted from the ship day.
Express is available in the contiguous 48.

**Is shipping free?**
Free over $45, and always free on subscriptions.

---

chunks.heading: Things we can't answer here
chunks.text:
## Things we can't answer here

The following need a human. If you're asking about one of these, we'll connect you with
someone rather than guess:

- **Wholesale, café accounts, and bulk pricing** — we do have a wholesale program, but
  terms, minimums and pricing are handled case by case by our accounts team.
- **Corporate gifting and custom/private label** — same, handled individually.
- **Press, partnerships, and collaborations.**
- **Anything medical** — caffeine and health conditions, pregnancy, medication
  interactions, allergen safety beyond what's on the label.
- **Legal requests, chargebacks in progress, and disputes.**
- **Refunds above $150**, which need a supervisor's approval.
- **Any request to change an order that has already shipped.**

chunks.heading: Reading the bag
chunks.text:
## Reading the bag

Every bag is stamped with a **roast date**, not a "best before" date. That's
deliberate — a best-before date tells you when coffee becomes undrinkable, which is
months away and useless. The roast date tells you where you are in the window where it
actually tastes good.
chunks.title: Freshness, Roast Dates & Storage

chunks.heading: The freshness window
chunks.text:
## The freshness window

| Days off roast | What's happening |
|---|---|
| 0–3 days | Still degassing. Filter is fine; espresso will gush and taste thin. |
| **4–21 days** | **The window.** This is where the coffee is at its best. |
| 21–35 days | Still good, gradually flattening. Aromatics fade first. |
| 35+ days | Drinkable, dull. Sweetness drops off, papery notes come in. |

Because we roast to order, coffee typically reaches you **2–5 days off roast**. If
you're pulling espresso, let it rest another 2–3 days before dialing in.
chunks.title: Freshness, Roast Dates & Storage

chunks.heading: Storage
chunks.text:
## Storage

**Do:** keep the bag sealed, at room temperature, out of direct sun. Our bags have a
one-way valve and a resealable strip — the bag it arrived in is the best container you
own. Press the air out before resealing.

**Don't:** store coffee in the fridge. It's humid and coffee absorbs odors — you'll get
notes of last week's leftovers.

**Freezing** works, but only if you do it properly: freeze in small, fully sealed,
single-dose portions, and never refreeze a portion once it's thawed. Condensation is
what ruins frozen coffee. For a bag you'll finish in three weeks, freezing is not worth
the trouble.
chunks.title: Freshness, Roast Dates & Storage

chunks.heading: Whole bean vs. ground
chunks.text:
## Whole bean vs. ground

Ground coffee stales roughly **an order of magnitude faster** than whole bean —
surface area is the enemy. Whole bean holds its window for about three weeks;
pre-ground is noticeably flatter after four or five days.

If you don't have a grinder, buy smaller bags more often rather than a large bag you'll
work through slowly. A 250g bag every two weeks beats a 1kg bag every eight.
chunks.title: Freshness, Roast Dates & Storage

chunks.heading: Common freshness complaints
chunks.text:
## Common freshness complaints

**"It tastes sour."** Usually under-extraction, not staleness. Grind finer or brew
hotter before you blame the beans.

**"It tastes flat and papery."** That's age. Check the roast date on the bag — if it's
more than 14 days before you received it, that's on us, and the returns policy covers
you.

**"There's no crema on my espresso."** Coffee that's too fresh (under 4 days) or too old
(over 5 weeks) both cause this. Check the roast date first.

**"The bag is puffed up."** That's CO₂ from a very fresh roast pushing through the
valve. It's a good sign.
chunks.title: Freshness, Roast Dates & Storage

chunks.heading: Returns & Refunds
chunks.text:
# Returns & Refunds

Coffee is a perishable food product, so our policy is different from a normal
returns policy. Read the section that matches your situation.
chunks.title: Returns & Refunds

chunks.heading: If something is wrong with the coffee
chunks.text:
## If something is wrong with the coffee

**We refund or replace, no return needed.** This covers:

- Wrong item or wrong grind shipped
- Bag arrived damaged, split, or with a broken one-way valve
- Coffee is stale, sour, or clearly defective
- Roast date on the bag is more than **14 days** before delivery

Contact us within **30 days of delivery** with your order number and a photo of the
bag label. We don't ask you to ship anything back — mailing coffee across the country
to be thrown away helps nobody.

Refunds go to the original payment method and post in **5–10 business days**
depending on your bank.
chunks.title: Returns & Refunds

chunks.heading: If you just don't like it
chunks.text:
## If you just don't like it

We'll make it right once. Tell us what you didn't like about it and we'll either send
a different coffee that suits your taste better, or refund that bag — **your choice**,
one time per customer.

Beyond that first time, we can't refund opened bags for preference. We'd rather help
you pick correctly than keep replacing bags: message us with your brewer and how you
take it, and we'll point you at the right roast.

**Unopened** bags can be refunded within **30 days of delivery**, no reason required.
Return shipping is on you unless the error was ours.
chunks.title: Returns & Refunds

chunks.heading: Equipment
chunks.text:
## Equipment

Unopened and unused equipment: **30 days**, full refund, you pay return shipping.
Opened or used equipment can only be returned if it's defective, in which case we
cover shipping both ways. Manufacturer warranties (grinders, scales) are handled by
the manufacturer — we'll give you the contact and the proof of purchase.
chunks.title: Returns & Refunds

chunks.heading: Subscriptions
chunks.text:
## Subscriptions

- A shipment that has **not yet been roasted** can be cancelled for a full refund
- A shipment that has **already shipped** can't be cancelled, but the coffee-quality
  rules above still apply
- We don't charge cancellation fees and we don't require a minimum number of shipments

See the subscription policy for pausing, skipping and frequency changes.
chunks.title: Returns & Refunds

chunks.heading: Gift orders
chunks.text:
## Gift orders

The gift recipient can request a replacement or an exchange directly — they don't
need the purchaser's permission and we won't tell the purchaser unless asked.
**Refunds go to the original payment method only**, which means the purchaser. We
can't refund a gift to the recipient.
chunks.title: Returns & Refunds

chunks.heading: What we don't refund
chunks.text:
## What we don't refund

- Shipping charges on a returned order, unless we made the error
- Orders reported more than **30 days** after delivery
- Coffee bought through a third-party retailer — take those to the retailer
chunks.title: Returns & Refunds

chunks.heading: Chargebacks
chunks.text:
## Chargebacks

If you open a chargeback we can't keep working the case with you; the bank takes over
and it takes 60–90 days. Message us first — we're faster and we say yes more often
than a bank does.
chunks.title: Returns & Refunds

chunks.heading: Roast-to-ship schedule
chunks.text:
## Roast-to-ship schedule

We roast **Mondays and Thursdays** and every bag ships the same day it's roasted.
Your coffee is never sitting in a warehouse.

- Order by **11:00 AM ET Sunday** → roasted and shipped **Monday**
- Order by **11:00 AM ET Wednesday** → roasted and shipped **Thursday**
- Orders placed after a cut-off go into the next roast

This means the longest you'll ever wait before your order ships is **4 days**, and
that only happens if you order Sunday afternoon.

Equipment-only orders (grinders, drippers, filters, mugs) don't wait for a roast day.
They ship **within 1 business day**. If an order contains both coffee and equipment,
the whole order ships together on the roast day unless you contact us to split it.
chunks.title: Shipping & Delivery

chunks.heading: Transit times
chunks.text:
## Transit times

Transit is counted from the ship date, not the order date.

| Destination | Standard (USPS Ground Advantage) | Express (UPS 2-Day) |
|---|---|---|
| FL, GA, AL, SC | 1–2 business days | 2 business days |
| Eastern & Midwest US | 2–4 business days | 2 business days |
| Mountain & Pacific US | 4–6 business days | 2 business days |
| AK, HI | 6–9 business days | not available |
chunks.title: Shipping & Delivery

chunks.heading: Shipping cost
chunks.text:
## Shipping cost

- **Free standard shipping on orders of $45 or more** (subtotal after discounts, before tax)
- Standard shipping under $45: **flat $6.50**
- Express (UPS 2-Day): **$14.95**, available to the contiguous 48 states only
- Subscriptions ship free at every order value, at every frequency
chunks.title: Shipping & Delivery

chunks.heading: Where we ship
chunks.text:
## Where we ship

All **50 US states**, plus **DC** and **Puerto Rico**. PO boxes and APO/FPO addresses
are supported on standard shipping only.

We do **not** ship internationally. There is no workaround, freight forwarder
arrangement, or exception process.
chunks.title: Shipping & Delivery

chunks.heading: Tracking
chunks.text:
## Tracking

Tracking is emailed the moment the label is scanned, usually between 5:00 and 7:00 PM
ET on the ship day. It can take USPS up to 24 hours to show the first movement scan —
a tracking number that says "label created" the next morning is normal and not a sign
of a problem.
chunks.title: Shipping & Delivery

chunks.heading: Late, lost and stolen packages
chunks.text:
## Late, lost and stolen packages

- **Delayed in transit:** if tracking hasn't moved in **5 business days**, contact us
  and we'll open a carrier trace and reship at no cost. We don't make you wait for the
  trace to close.
- **Marked delivered but missing:** check with neighbors and your building first, then
  contact us within **7 days** of the delivery scan. We reship once per address at no
  charge.
- **Damaged in transit:** send a photo of the box and the bag. We reship immediately.
  Don't return the damaged item — keep it or compost the coffee.
chunks.title: Shipping & Delivery

chunks.heading: Address changes
chunks.text:
## Address changes

We can change an address only **before the roast-day cut-off**. Once a label is
printed we can't intercept it. If a package is returned to us as undeliverable we'll
refund the coffee but not the original shipping.
chunks.title: Shipping & Delivery

chunks.heading: Weather and carrier holidays
chunks.text:
## Weather and carrier holidays

We don't ship on federal holidays. During hurricane season (June–November) Florida
closures can push a roast day by 24–48 hours; we email everyone affected before the
scheduled ship date.
chunks.title: Shipping & Delivery

chunks.heading: How it works
chunks.text:
## How it works

Pick a coffee, a grind, a size and a frequency. We roast and ship on your schedule
and charge the card on file the morning of the roast day.

**Frequencies:** every 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 or 8 weeks.

**Subscriber benefits:**
- **10% off** every shipment, forever, stacked on top of any size discount
- **Free shipping** at every order value
- First access to microlots before they go on the public site
- No minimum commitment, no cancellation fee
chunks.title: Subscriptions

chunks.heading: Managing your subscription
chunks.text:
## Managing your subscription

Everything is self-serve in your account under **Manage subscription**:

| Action | Deadline | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Skip next shipment | before the charge | Skipping doesn't shift your schedule |
| Pause | before the charge | Pause for 2, 4, 8 weeks or indefinitely |
| Change coffee, grind or size | before the charge | Price adjusts automatically |
| Change frequency | any time | New frequency starts after the next shipment |
| Change address | before the roast-day cut-off | Same as one-time orders |
| Cancel | any time | Takes effect immediately |

**The charge happens at 6:00 AM ET on the roast day** (Monday or Thursday). Any change
made before that moment applies to that shipment. After it, the shipment is locked.

If you miss the window, message us the same morning — if it hasn't been roasted yet
we can usually still catch it. That's a courtesy, not a guarantee.
chunks.title: Subscriptions

chunks.heading: Failed payments
chunks.text:
## Failed payments

If the card declines we retry on **day 1, day 3 and day 7**. You get an email each
time with a link to update the card. After the third failure the subscription pauses
automatically — it is **not** cancelled, and your discount and position are kept. Fix
the card and it resumes on the next roast day.
chunks.title: Subscriptions

chunks.heading: Gift subscriptions
chunks.text:
## Gift subscriptions

Prepaid for 3, 6 or 12 shipments. The recipient gets an email on the date you pick
and can choose their own coffee and grind from what you prepaid. Gift subscriptions
don't auto-renew — nobody gets a surprise charge. When the shipments run out we email
the recipient once, and that's the end of it unless they subscribe themselves.
chunks.title: Subscriptions

chunks.heading: Price changes
chunks.text:
## Price changes

If we have to raise prices we email every active subscriber **30 days ahead**. Your
current price holds for any shipment already scheduled inside that window.
chunks.title: Subscriptions

chunks.heading: What subscriptions don't cover
chunks.text:
## What subscriptions don't cover

Equipment can't be put on a subscription. Decaf is available on subscription, but
single-origin microlots are not — they sell out, and we won't promise a bag we can't
guarantee we'll have.
